title: Unified platform contracts v1, audit hash chain with Event Log anchors, and licence and provenance gates (inert)
draft_note: Activation-ready draft under prep/ (revision 6). It becomes active only when the activation PR (WP1-00) copies it into .specgrain/specs/ with this field removed, the founder decisions of 2026-11-17 recorded in CURRENT.md and planning_issue set.

dependency_notes.SG-000093: Closed. AuthorityMode, ExecutorClass and ExecutionState move to orcel-contracts with identical serde spellings and are re-exported by orcel-policy; lease ids and binding digests keep their encodings.

objective: Give every unified-platform grain one set of versioned wire contracts in crates/orcel-contracts (principal and device, per-OS identity binding, lease view, grant reference bound to session and client, standing approval, session, tool registry entry, capability discovery with unsupported and permission_required, the job state machine reusing not_started|dispatched|completed|cancelled|outcome_unknown, the audit event, sidecar IPC, web crawl request with scope, headers, privacy profile and declared task, and additive failure codes with a complete HTTP mapping); a SHA-256 hash chain in orcel-audit written before every dispatch and anchored in the Windows Event Log; `orcel audit verify` checking every anchor still in the log; and CI gates for licences per crate, package and component, AGPL markers outside the isolated Firecrawl component and FD-06 paths, provenance of every copied directory, and the kernel dependency direction. Nothing becomes reachable by any client. Spec: docs/orcel/implementation-readiness/prep/UNIFIED_INTEGRATION_SPEC.md sections 3, 4.0 to 4.10, 8.2 (WP1-01, WP1-02, WP1-03).

include: WP1-01: root deny.toml; scripts/check-npm-licenses.mjs, check-agpl-markers.mjs (allowed only under apps/orcel-firecrawl/ and docs/orcel/notices/fd06-files.txt paths) and check-provenance.mjs (PROVENANCE.json for every upstream, third_party or vendor directory), each with tests; crates/orceld/tests/dependency_direction.rs; ci.yml wiring.

WP1-02: the contract modules listed in section 8.2 of the spec, golden fixtures, schemars =1.2.3 as a dev-dependency with a schema drift test, canonical_json with the SG-000093/SG-000018/SG-000019/SG-000040 exemptions, the FailureCode variants of section 4.10 and FailureCode::http_status.

WP1-03: chain.rs, verify.rs and anchor.rs in orcel-audit; write-before-dispatch in orceld with refusal on failure; Event Log anchors (event id 4100) through the registered source when the authority service is installed, otherwise an unregistered per-user source proven under a standard account; `orcel audit verify`; digests only for argv, URLs, query strings and header values.
exclude: Any MCP tool, REST route, executor, runtime dependency in crates/*, listener, network path or authority.
Any change to lease issuance, lease ids, binding digests, existing approval digests or Safe-mode policy.
macOS unified log and Linux journal anchors (track X).

authority_delta.audit: None in what is permitted; adds integrity evidence and refuses a dispatch whose evidence cannot be written.

decisions.question: Grain id and activation
decisions.status: DECIDED (founder, 2026-11-17, FD-UP-4): SG-000131 covers contracts, the audit chain and licence and provenance checks.

decisions.question: Licensing approach
decisions.status: DECIDED (founder, 2026-11-17, FD-UP-1): core independently licensed; copy-first AGPL code only in the isolated component; founder attestation recorded separately (docs/orcel/grants/2026-11-17-founder-attestation.md).

invariants: orcel-contracts depends only on serde and serde_json at runtime and contains no platform code.
Existing wire spellings, the orcel-full-control-lease/1 schema and existing digests are unchanged.
Inbound authority-bearing objects refuse unknown fields; LeaseView is never proof.
No dispatch runs without its audit record durably written first.
Audit records never contain a raw SID, token, credential, header value, argv, URL or page content.
No kernel crate depends on an app, test, package or third_party unit, and no Apache unit links an AGPL unit.
Every copied directory carries a pinned PROVENANCE.json and its licence text.
acceptance: Every contract type round-trips its golden fixture; unknown fields refused where required; schema drift fails CI; every FailureCode is mapped.
orcel-policy tests pass unchanged after the vocabulary move.
Edits, deletions, reorders and tail truncation are reported by `orcel audit verify`; a conflicting anchor record is a break; rotation keeps continuity.
A simulated audit write failure refuses the dispatch.
The anchor write and read-back succeed and clearing the log is refused under a temporary standard account on the Windows runner.
The licence, AGPL-marker, provenance and dependency-direction gates pass on main and fail on their fixtures.
